newsitem.title: USA: HARD ROCK CAFE SIGNS RESORT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: HARD ROCK CAFE SIGNS RESORT DEAL.

text.p: Hard Rock Cafe International Inc, a unit of Rank Group Plc, said Monday it has signed an agreement with a Singapore-based company, Leisure Ventures Pte Ltd, to develop at least seven music-themed resorts worldwide.

Leisure Ventures is 50 percent owned by Hotel Properties Ltd, through its wholly owned subsidiary HPL Singapore Pte Ltd. The remaining 50 percent is owned by entrepreneur Ong Beng Seng, through Rizonia Hong Kong Ltd.

The first resort is under construction in Bali and is scheduled to open in the spring of 1998. The $70 million Bali Hard Rock Hotel & Beach Club will have 421 rooms plus a Hard Rock Cafe and a concert facility, Hard Rock said in a statement.
Under terms of the deal, Leisure Ventures will develop and operate the resorts. Hard Rock will receive an initial licensing fee plus royalties based on a percentage of gross receipts for each resort.
Leisure Ventures is expected to develop at least seven and as many as 12 hotels and resorts in the next 12 years, Hard Rock said.
